extracted.name: Hot Corn
extracted.description: In this hot corn dish recipe, corn and jalapeños are smothered with a cream cheese, butter and milk sauce, topped with Cheddar cheese, and then baked.
ingredient_lines: 4 (15 ounce) cans whole kernel corn, drained
1 (12 ounce) jar jalapeno peppers, drained and diced
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Combine cream cheese, butter, and milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat; stir until smooth.
Combine corn and jalapeños in a 9x13-inch baking dish; pour in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
